summary.zh: 规划早期团队结构、招聘与股权
summary.en: Plan early-stage team structure, hiring, and equity.

description.zh: 设计早期公司的组织架构、招聘节奏、薪酬区间与股权分配，并与融资节点对齐。适合规划下一批要招的岗位、编制用人预算，或调整团队结构。
description.en: Designs org structure, hiring sequence, compensation ranges, and equity allocation for early-stage startups, aligned to funding milestones. Fits headcount planning, hiring budgets, or reshaping a team.
